messages:
maria: Compliance pinged again. They need an automated nightly bundle of routing-policy changes (who/when/what) across tenants for legal review. They want the full change payload and some form of actor identifier. Thoughts on minimizing PII exposure?
sam: i'd default to a reversible pseudonym unless customer opts in for full identities. store per-tenant salt so mapping is tenant-scoped. also ask compliance what their retention window is.
akash: agree on per-tenant salt + sha256(user_id + salt). call it `actor_hash`. provide an enterprise-only flow that returns `actor_email` after an admin auth check. keep presigned links short.
leah: UI-wise: two export modes in console: "pseudonymized" (default) and "reveal identities" (enterprise only, audit-gated). show a red banner when revealed identities are included. require 2-step confirm.
nina: API schema proposal: add `actor_hash`, `actor_revealed` (bool), `actor_display` (nullable string). sample event: ```{\n  \"ts\": \"2026-03-20T05:00:00Z\",\n  \"resource\": \"tenant/123/routes/abc\",\n  \"action\": \"update\",\n  \"diff\": { ... },\n  \"actor_hash\": \"sha256:...\",\n  \"actor_revealed\": false,\n  \"actor_display\": null\n}```
maria: good. we also need a manifest.json at top of export bundle with metadata: `actor_revealed`, `redaction_policy`, `rows`, `size_bytes`, `sha256_of_bundle`. makes it obvious to downstream consumers.
akash: presigned URL TTL: default 24h, configurable up to 7d for enterprise. sign bundle with HMAC and include `manifest.signature`. also emit telemetry event when manifest indicates revealed=true so we can audit who requested it.
leah: redaction granularity: per-attribute rules (email, ip, session_id). console should let tenant admins pick a policy preset: strict, default, permissive. store policy in tenant settings and apply on export generation.
sam: quotas: rate-limit exports per-tenant and per-user. daily export cap default 5 full exports, unlimited pseudonymized but with cost warnings. also spike detection: if export size > 10x baseline for tenant -> alert ops and pause large exports pending review.
nina: rollout plan: behind flag `audit_export_v3`. canary 2% for 3 days, 10% next week, 50% then 100%. backend: export worker reads tenant policy, applies redactions, writes bundle to s3 and places manifest.
akash: implementation note: compute `actor_hash = fn:sha256(user_id || tenant_salt)` and persist tenant_salt in KMS-encrypted store. reversible mapping only via admin API that requires two approvals or special scope.
maria: telemetry keys: `export.mode` (pseudonymized/revealed), `export.rows`, `export.size_bytes`, `export.duration_ms`, `export.tenant_id`, `export.requestor`. log sampling at 100% for revealed exports.
leah: console UX: show estimated number of rows and transfer size before confirming. show egress cost estimate and an explicit checkbox "I understand this may include user identities" when revealed. add a small help tooltip explaining redaction presets.
sam: file format: NDJSON with `manifest.json` + `data/changes.ndjson` + `checksums.txt`. manifest should have `redaction_policy` array listing attributes scrubbed.
nina: tests: add unit tests for per-attribute redaction matrix + integration test that manifest accurately reflects output.
akash: security review: ensure worker doesn't log raw emails when redaction enabled. add audit log entries when admin uses reveal mapping API.
maria: action items: (1) sam -> API PR with `actor_hash` + `actor_revealed` + manifest schema, (2) akash -> export worker salt handling + HMAC signing + tests, (3) leah -> console mockups for flows + cost/confirm UX, (4) nina -> telemetry/event schema and quota enforcement plan. i'll create tickets and assign.
export-bot: nightly-export job scheduled for tenant 123 at 2026-03-20T05:00:00Z :hourglass:
maria: thanks all. i'll loop compliance into the design review next week. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
